verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only official SDKs and platform libraries (bugsnag-docs-16, bugsnag-gh-1/2) with no documentation of a public/open event-ingestion API or protocol spec; probes explicitly confirm no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt is published (bugsnag-probe-1, bugsnag-probe-2), meaning there's no evidence a custom client could construct compliant payloads without the official SDK.
